content.overview: The memorandum and the articles (duly signed by the subscribers) must be presented for registration. The articles shall contain the mutual-assistance principles set out in section 378G(2) (voluntary membership, single vote, Board accountability, limited return, equitable surplus distribution, education, and cooperation among Producer Companies) and the additional provisions listed in section 378G(3) (membership qualifications, transfer of shares, Board composition, meetings, Chief Executive, and related governance matters).
content.glance: Articles must embed mutual-assistance principles and the mandatory governance provisions of s. 378G.
content.study: Section 378G requires the articles to be presented with the memorandum and to contain both the mutual-assistance principles and the specific governance clauses the section enumerates. Membership is voluntary and open to eligible persons willing to accept membership duties; each Member has a single vote (save as otherwise provided); the Board is accountable to the Members; return on capital is limited; surplus is distributed equitably for business development, common facilities and reserves; education on mutual assistance is required; and cooperation among Producer Companies is encouraged. The articles also regulate qualifications, continuance and cancellation of membership, share transfer, Board size and election, meetings, and the Chief Executive.
